name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Mary Moon and Marcus Moon, who never married but never left each other either. She was a chef, he was an engineer. Nothing extravagant, but nobody checked the price of things. You were the youngest of 3: Linda and Karen were already running the house. Your father Marcus ran lights at the local theatre and let you sit in the empty stalls. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Mary Moon and Marcus Moon — a comfortable household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.
